items.title: Awesome Typescript
items.content_text:
### Web / Playground

*   :octocat: [Fedify (⭐843)](https://github.com/fedify-dev/fedify) - TypeScript framework for building federated server apps powered by ActivityPub and the fediverse

### Platform Engineering & DevOps / Playground

*   :octocat: [CDK8s](https://cdk8s.io/) - Define Kubernetes applications and reusable abstractions using TypeScript
*   :octocat: [AWS CDK (⭐12k)](https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk) - Cloud Development Kit for defining cloud infrastructure in TypeScript
*   :octocat: [Pulumi (⭐24k)](https://github.com/pulumi/pulumi) - Infrastructure as Code using TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and .NET
*   :octocat: [Backstage (⭐31k)](https://github.com/backstage/backstage) - Platform for building developer portals, written in TypeScript
